## Problem

Investigate why a spam classifier that shows strong offline metrics still misses a substantial share of spam in live traffic. After diagnosing the root cause, propose changes to feature extraction, model architecture or training, rollout experiments, and drift monitoring.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

Start by asking what differs between offline training data and live traffic — label leakage, temporal drift, or feature staleness are common culprits.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Consider the pipeline as separate stages: feature extraction, model scoring, thresholding, and feedback collection, each with its own failure modes.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

Plan a rollout with shadow scoring and A/B tests, plus drift monitors on feature distributions and prediction rates rather than just accuracy.

</details>
